references.text: The account of Moses and Aaron's disobedience at the waters of Meribah, where they did not honor the Lord in the sight of the Israelites, which led to them being barred from entering the Promised Land.
The Lord reminds Moses of his rebellion at the waters of Meribah in the wilderness of Zin, where he failed to honor God before the people.
The principle that God must be honored by those who are close to Him, which Moses and Aaron did not do at Meribah.
Ezekiel describes Israel's repeated rebellion against the Lord, paralleling Israel's actions in the wilderness.
The psalmist mentions the incident at the waters of Meribah where Moses was punished because of the people's rebellion.
Aaron is to be gathered to his fathers because he and Moses were rebellious against the Lord's command at the waters of Meribah.
Moses recounts that the Lord became angry with him on account of the people and refused to let him cross the Jordan.
